{{Top|leg}}
The '''Quohag sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The military forces of this sector used [[Red Hydra pistol]]s until the weapons were decomissioned by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] order.<ref>{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=item|Red Hydra Z-5 Pistol}}</ref>{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that the Quohag sector was validated for a future map of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
